animations.name: slideUp
animations.css: @keyframes slideUp { from { bottom: 0; opacity: 0; } to { bottom: 1rem; opacity: 1; } }
animations.description: Slides element up from bottom with fade-in effect, used for fixed positioned elements

animations.name: slideDown
animations.css: @keyframes slideDown { from { bottom: 1rem; opacity: 1; } to { bottom: 0; opacity: 0; } }
animations.description: Slides element down with fade-out effect, reverse of slideUp

animations.name: sonner-fade-in
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.8) } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } }
animations.description: Scale and fade entrance animation for toast notifications

animations.name: sonner-fade-out
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-out { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.8) } }
animations.description: Scale and fade exit animation for toast notifications

animations.name: sonner-spin
animations.description: Loading spinner opacity animation for toast loading states

animations.name: swipe-out-left
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out-left { from { transform: var(--y) translateX(var(--swipe-amount-x)); opacity: 1 } to { transform: var(--y) translateX(calc(var(--swipe-amount-x) - 100%)); opacity: 0 } }
animations.description: Swipe dismissal animation for toasts swiped left

animations.name: swipe-out-right
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out-right { from { transform: var(--y) translateX(var(--swipe-amount-x)); opacity: 1 } to { transform: var(--y) translateX(calc(var(--swipe-amount-x) + 100%)); opacity: 0 } }
animations.description: Swipe dismissal animation for toasts swiped right

animations.name: swipe-out-up
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out-up { from { transform: var(--y) translateY(var(--swipe-amount-y)); opacity: 1 } to { transform: var(--y) translateY(calc(var(--swipe-amount-y) - 100%)); opacity: 0 } }
animations.description: Swipe dismissal animation for toasts swiped up

animations.name: swipe-out-down
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out-down { from { transform: var(--y) translateY(var(--swipe-amount-y)); opacity: 1 } to { transform: var(--y) translateY(calc(var(--swipe-amount-y) + 100%)); opacity: 0 } }
animations.description: Swipe dismissal animation for toasts swiped down

animations.name: enter-fade-rise
animations.css: animation: enter-fade .39s ease-out var(--enter-delay,0s) both, enter-rise .65s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.4, .64, 1) var(--enter-delay,0s) both
animations.description: Combined fade and rise animation for QR code card entrance with spring easing

animations.name: hover-scale-transform
animations.description: Scale transform on hover for QR code card, scales to 1.08 on hover/focus

insights: The design uses a strictly monochromatic color palette with black, white, and gray tones, creating high contrast and visual clarity for authentication flows.
All buttons use rounded-full (pill shape) with 9999px border-radius, creating a consistent modern aesthetic across primary, secondary, and tertiary button variants.
The authentication form implements a progressive disclosure pattern where the Continue button changes from disabled gray to active black state only when input is provided, guiding user behavior.
